_comment: How this tree is previewed. Read by scripts/preview_config.py; the generic
verb in scripts/shoot.mjs never sees any of these values as literals.
An app that has a workshop.app.json declares the same block THERE, under
the `preview` key; this sidecar exists because the platform's own source
tree has no service manifest (systemd starts its services, not app_runner).
Any string may use ${VAR} or ${VAR:-fallback} to read the environment.
origin: the public edge, which serves the BUILT bundle. That is what the
operator looks at, so it is what a review shot must come from.
auth: this install authenticates a browser with a session cookie, so the
command below mints one for the operator's user and prints it.
touch_below: 900 is the frontend's own WIDE breakpoint.

auth.name: workshop_session
auth.token_command: cd backend && ./.venv/bin/python3 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'.'); from services import auth_store; print(auth_store.create_session(${WORKSHOP_PREVIEW_USER_ID:-6}, user_agent='agent-screenshot'))"
